title: Successful login with valid user ID and password
steps: 1. Open internet banking login. 2. Enter valid retail user ID and password. 3. Submit.
expected: Customer is authenticated and the account summary is displayed. No OTP is required on a trusted device.

title: Login rejected for invalid password
steps: 1. Enter a valid user ID. 2. Enter an incorrect password. 3. Submit.
expected: Generic invalid-credentials message is shown. Account summary is not displayed. Remaining attempts are not disclosed beyond bank policy.

title: User ID locked after three consecutive failed logins
steps: 1. Enter a valid user ID with a wrong password three times. 2. On the fourth try enter the correct password.
expected: After the third failure the ID is locked. The fourth attempt is rejected with a lock message even if the password is correct.

title: Login MFA succeeds with valid SMS OTP
steps: 1. Login from a new browser profile with valid password. 2. Enter the 6-digit SMS OTP within validity.
expected: OTP is accepted, session is created, and the device can be marked trusted.

title: Login MFA rejected for expired OTP
steps: 1. Trigger OTP on a new device. 2. Wait until the OTP expires. 3. Submit the expired code.
expected: Expired OTP is rejected. Login is not completed. Customer can request a new OTP.

title: Login MFA rejected for invalid OTP
steps: 1. Trigger OTP on a new device. 2. Enter an incorrect 6-digit code.
expected: Invalid OTP error is shown. Session is not established.

title: Idle session times out after 10 minutes
steps: 1. Login successfully. 2. Leave the session idle for 10 minutes. 3. Attempt to open account details.
expected: Customer is redirected to login with a session-expired message. Protected pages are not accessible.

title: Explicit logout invalidates the session
steps: 1. Login. 2. Click Logout. 3. Use the browser Back button to the summary URL.
expected: Session is invalidated. Back navigation does not show account data. Login is required.

title: New device always challenges MFA even with correct password
steps: 1. Login with valid credentials from a cleared-cookie browser.
expected: Password is accepted then OTP challenge is presented before account summary.

title: Password reset with mobile OTP then login with new password
steps: 1. Choose Forgot password. 2. Authenticate with registered mobile OTP. 3. Set a new complex password. 4. Login with the new password.
expected: Reset succeeds. Old password is no longer valid. New password opens internet banking.

title: Account summary lists all eligible retail accounts
steps: 1. Login as a customer with savings, current, and FD. 2. Open Account summary.
expected: Each eligible account is listed with product type, masked number, nickname, and available balance.

title: Savings and current available balances match the channel snapshot
steps: 1. Note core/channel snapshot balances for savings and current. 2. Open summary.
expected: Displayed available balances match the snapshot for both CASA accounts.

title: Hide and show balances on summary
steps: 1. On summary click Hide balances. 2. Click Show balances.
expected: Amounts are masked when hidden and restored when shown without an error.

title: Account details show recent posted transactions
steps: 1. From summary open a current account with activity. 2. Review the transaction list.
expected: At least the last 10 posted transactions show date, description, debit/credit, and running balance.

title: New customer with a single zero-balance account still sees summary
steps: 1. Login as a newly onboarded customer with one savings account at zero.
expected: Summary loads with one account and 0.00 available balance. No empty-state crash.

title: Joint account shows joint indicator on details
steps: 1. Open a joint savings account.
expected: Joint indicator is visible. Transactions still load for the operating customer.

title: Own-account transfer from savings to current succeeds
steps: 1. Transfer 500.00 from savings to own current. 2. Confirm on the review screen. 3. Submit.
expected: Both ledgers update. Receipt shows a channel reference. Summary balances reflect the movement.

title: IMPS transfer to an active beneficiary succeeds
steps: 1. Select an active beneficiary. 2. Choose IMPS. 3. Enter an amount within IMPS and daily limits. 4. Confirm.
expected: Payment is accepted with an IMPS reference. Beneficiary account is credited in the simulator.

title: Transfer blocked when amount exceeds available balance
steps: 1. Start a beneficiary transfer for available balance plus 1.00. 2. Continue to confirm.
expected: Insufficient-funds error is shown. No debit is posted.

title: Third-party transfer blocked when daily limit is exhausted
steps: 1. Note remaining daily limit. 2. Attempt a beneficiary transfer above remaining daily limit.
expected: Transfer is blocked for daily-limit breach before OTP. No debit is posted.

title: Third-party transfer blocked when per-transaction limit is exceeded
steps: 1. Enter an amount above the per-transaction cap but within available balance.
expected: Per-transaction limit error is shown on the amount step. Confirm is not offered.

title: Own-account transfer requires a confirmation screen
steps: 1. Capture from account, to account, amount, remarks. 2. Click Continue.
expected: Review screen shows from, to, amount, and remarks. Submit is available only from review.

title: High-value beneficiary transfer requires OTP
steps: 1. Enter a beneficiary amount above the high-value threshold. 2. Confirm.
expected: OTP challenge is presented. Transfer commits only after a valid OTP.

title: Future-dated beneficiary transfer is stored as pending
steps: 1. Choose a date 3 business days ahead. 2. Amount within limits. 3. Confirm.
expected: Instruction is saved as Pending with the value date. Immediate debit does not occur.

title: Duplicate transfer warning on repeat submit within two minutes
steps: 1. Complete a 100.00 beneficiary transfer. 2. Immediately repeat the same beneficiary and amount.
expected: Duplicate-transaction warning is shown. Customer can cancel or confirm a second payment.

title: Pay a registered electricity biller
steps: 1. Open Bill pay. 2. Select a registered electricity biller. 3. Enter a valid amount. 4. Confirm.
expected: Payment succeeds. Receipt shows biller name, consumer number, amount, and reference.

title: Register a new water biller with a valid consumer number
steps: 1. Add biller. 2. Category Water. 3. Select biller. 4. Enter a valid consumer number. 5. Save.
expected: Biller is saved as Active and appears on the bill-pay list.

title: Add biller rejected for invalid consumer number
steps: 1. Add biller. 2. Enter a consumer number the biller network rejects.
expected: Biller-network validation error is shown. Record is not saved.

title: Fetch outstanding and pay credit-card biller
steps: 1. Select a fetch-enabled card biller. 2. Fetch bill. 3. Pay the fetched outstanding.
expected: Fetched amount is the default. Payment posts for that amount with a receipt.

title: Schedule a future bill payment
steps: 1. On a registered biller choose Pay later. 2. Set a future date and amount. 3. Confirm.
expected: Scheduled bill pay appears as Pending. Immediate debit does not occur.

title: Add a new IMPS beneficiary with account number and IFSC
steps: 1. Add beneficiary. 2. Enter name, account number, IFSC. 3. Confirm with OTP.
expected: Beneficiary is created in Cooling-off status. It appears on the payee list.

title: Transfer to a beneficiary still in cool-off is blocked
steps: 1. Add a beneficiary. 2. Immediately start a transfer to that payee.
expected: Transfer is blocked with a cool-off message until the cooling period ends.

title: Delete an existing beneficiary
steps: 1. Open an active beneficiary. 2. Delete and confirm.
expected: Beneficiary is removed from the payee list and cannot be selected for transfer.

title: Edit beneficiary nickname without resetting cool-off on an active payee
steps: 1. Open an active beneficiary. 2. Change nickname only. 3. Save.
expected: Nickname updates. Status remains Active. Cool-off is not reapplied.

title: Duplicate beneficiary account number is rejected
steps: 1. Add a beneficiary using an account number already saved for this customer.
expected: Duplicate account error is shown. Second beneficiary is not created.

title: View last 30 days of posted transactions
steps: 1. Open Statements for current account. 2. Leave the default date range.
expected: Transactions for the last 30 days are listed. Pending authorizations are excluded or labelled.

title: Download statement as PDF
steps: 1. Choose a valid date range within 12 months. 2. Download PDF.
expected: A PDF file downloads and contains the account number (masked) and the selected period.

title: Download statement as CSV
steps: 1. Choose a valid date range. 2. Download CSV.
expected: CSV downloads with date, description, debit, credit columns for posted transactions.

title: Statement date range rejected when end is before start
steps: 1. Set start date after end date. 2. Search.
expected: Validation error is shown. No statement is produced.

title: Email statement to registered email only
steps: 1. Choose Email statement for a valid range. 2. Submit.
expected: Statement is queued to the registered email. The UI does not allow an arbitrary address.

title: Cards hub lists debit and credit cards with masked PAN
steps: 1. Open Cards.
expected: Each linked card shows product name, status, linked account, and PAN masked except last 4.

title: Temporary block of debit card
steps: 1. Select an active debit card. 2. Block card and confirm.
expected: Status becomes Blocked. Subsequent simulated POS is declined.

title: Unblock a previously blocked debit card
steps: 1. On a blocked debit card choose Unblock. 2. Confirm OTP if prompted.
expected: Status returns to Active.

title: Set debit-card PIN with OTP
steps: 1. Choose Set PIN. 2. Enter new PIN and confirm. 3. Submit OTP.
expected: PIN change is accepted. Success message is shown. PIN value is never displayed.

title: Toggle international usage on a debit card
steps: 1. Disable international usage. 2. Re-enable international usage.
expected: Each toggle persists after refresh. Status matches the last action.

title: View bank max
steps: and remaining limit
column7: Screen shows bank maximum, customer daily third-party limit, per-transaction cap, and remaining today.

title: Increase daily transfer limit within bank maximum
steps: 1. Set daily limit below bank max and above current usage. 2. Confirm OTP if required.
expected: New daily limit is saved and remaining today is recalculated.

title: Reject daily limit above bank maximum
steps: 1. Enter a daily limit greater than bank max. 2. Save.
expected: Validation error is shown. Previous limit remains in force.

title: Enable SMS alerts for debits
steps: 1. Open Alerts. 2. Enable SMS for debit transactions. 3. Save. 4. Logout and login.
expected: SMS debit alerts show as On after re-login.

title: Disable email alerts for successful login
steps: 1. Open Alerts. 2. Disable email login alerts. 3. Save.
expected: Preference persists as Off. No email login alert is queued for the next login in the simulator.
